review_findings.derivation: For the exact equal-dual, fixed-geometry linear baseline, xau=Delta(uDebye)/(2h*DEBYE*BOHR). The native field conversion gives dchi/dtheta=-g*xau^T*Htheta,au*xau with g=K/(HARTREE*BOHR), equivalent to -K*BOHR^2/HARTREE times sum[f/alpha_A3*(n dot xau)^2]. b and c signs/scaling are correct; c multiplies eta and a is identically zero.
review_findings.dual_applicability: Intact OHH graphs and frozen water polarization groups eliminate intrawater d/p fields equally; separated groups have equal factors. Both native right-hand sides receive the same uniform field. This permits uind-only response here, without generalizing to unequal dual fields.
review_findings.raw_and_alpha: Exact admitted19 result/manifest/review and complete comparison are pinned. Raw induced filenames/pins, site count/order/native names and saved vectors are checked. XYZ type order/parent indices and all positive key-over-prm alphas are retained; actual type36 alpha=.837 A^3 in all four rows.
review_findings.rounding: Per-site half-last-digit bounds propagate through centered response, radial dot products, squares, both derivatives and absolute sums for derived rows. They are printing bounds only, not bounds on solver or reference error.
review_findings.rank: Two exact zero drive columns remain. Per-metal triangular b/c blocks and nested c=0 stiffness columns give the correct singular values/rank convention; repeated steps are reported independently without adding physical rank.
review_findings.envelopes: min(coefficient-box triangle bound, per-site sigma triangle bound) is a valid conservative first-order absolute bound. The same construction with absolute coefficient propagation is valid for derived contrasts, and restriction to b columns preserves the nested-four bound. It neither selects coefficients nor certifies finite-parameter feasibility.
review_findings.denominator_and_failures: Four fixed states, two exact existing steps and six parameter columns; all derived comparison rows retained. Missing pins/shape/order/induction/closure reject the saved calculation. CLI preserves any pre-existing output directory and records failures on fresh attempts.
